title: Mitigating Political Bias in Language Models Through Reinforced Calibration

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the liberal or conservative leaning of generated texts using a fine-tuned XLNet classifier, measuring 'Indirect Bias' based on neutral attribute keywords and 'Direct Bias' using explicit ideological prompts.
Measuring discrepancies in the political ideology of generated text when the model is prompted with male versus female names.
Evaluating ideological differences in generated text when prompted with names of different US states categorized by their political voting history (e.g., red states vs. blue states).
